aBusinessUpdates: UPDATE "OAuthSession" SET "expiresAt" = LEAST("expiresAt", CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE "workspaceId" IS NULL;

queries.name: identity
queries.sql: SELECT current_database(),current_user,current_setting('transaction_read_only') read_only,current_setting('nexus.workspace_id',true) workspace,now() db_time

queries.name: prerequisites
queries.sql: SELECT to_regclass('public."Workspace"') workspace,to_regclass('public."WorkspaceMembership"') membership,EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='nexus_workspace_runtime') runtime_role

queries.name: role-capabilities
queries.sql: SELECT rolname,rolsuper,rolcreaterole,rolbypassrls FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname IN (current_user,'nexus_workspace_runtime')

queries.name: owner-preconditions
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*)::int FROM "AccountSettings") settings,(SELECT count(DISTINCT u.id)::int FROM "UserProfile" u JOIN "UserRole" ur ON ur."userId"=u.id JOIN "Role" r ON r.id=ur."roleId" WHERE u.status='active' AND r.key='OWNER') active_owners,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM "UserProfile" u WHERE u.status='active' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "UserRole" ur WHERE ur."userId"=u.id)) members_to_copy,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM "UserRole" WHERE "channelScope" IS NOT NULL AND "channelScope" NOT IN ('null'::jsonb,'{}'::jsonb)) scoped_assignments,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM "Invitation" WHERE "channelScope" IS NOT NULL AND "channelScope" NOT IN ('null'::jsonb,'{}'::jsonb) AND "acceptedAt" IS NULL AND "revokedAt" IS NULL AND "expiresAt">now()) scoped_invitations,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM "ChannelConnection") connections,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM "OAuthSession") oauth_sessions

queries.name: missing-b-tables
queries.sql: SELECT name FROM unnest($1::text[]) name WHERE to_regclass(format('public.%I',name)) IS NULL ORDER BY name

queries.name: missing-b-drop-indexes
queries.sql: SELECT name FROM unnest($1::text[]) name WHERE to_regclass(format('public.%I',name)) IS NULL ORDER BY name

queries.name: workspace-column-coverage
queries.sql: SELECT count(*)::int workspace_columns FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND column_name='workspaceId'

queries.name: presence-columns
queries.sql: SELECT column_name,data_type,is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='ChannelListing' AND (column_name LIKE 'presence%' OR column_name LIKE 'channelFact%' OR column_name IN ('endedAt','endedBy','endedReason','saleStopId'))

queries.name: unresolved-migrations
queries.sql: SELECT migration_name FROM _prisma_migrations WHERE finished_at IS NULL AND rolled_back_at IS NULL

queries.name: prerequisite-migration-records
queries.sql: SELECT migration_name,finished_at,rolled_back_at FROM _prisma_migrations WHERE migration_name LIKE '20260908%' ORDER BY migration_name,started_at

queries.name: positive-control
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT version FROM "Product" WHERE id='cmokmy3a40078pm0p1fvnu523') gale_version,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM "Product") products,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM "ChannelListing") listings
